data.title: 玄关门后藏不住的生日惊喜
data.location: 微微敞开的温馨公寓木门玄关
data.lighting: 蛋糕细烛火暖橙微光与玄关顶灯
data.prompt: 1girl, solo, shiki_natsume, dusty rose loose mohair knit sweater, dark grey cotton shorts, over-knee home socks, standing inside half-open apartment doorway, holding small strawberry shortcake on porcelain plate with lit birthday candle, looking slightly away with crimson blush, quiet tender smile, wooden door frame foreground, warm candle glow lighting face and amber eyes, cozy dimmed hallway, pov, medium shot
data.animaCaption: Standing just inside the half-open apartment doorway in a soft dusty-rose mohair sweater, she holds a strawberry shortcake with a single flickering birthday candle while looking half away in flustered sincerity. Warm candle glow illuminates her golden eyes and the mole beneath her eye.
data.promptProse: Seen from the threshold through a half-opened wooden apartment door in the foreground, Shiki Natsume waits in the softly dimmed entryway dressed in a cozy dusty-rose mohair knit sweater, dark grey lounge shorts, and over-knee cotton socks. Cradling a porcelain saucer bearing a strawberry shortcake topped with one glowing birthday candle, she averts her gaze a fraction with flushed cheeks and a barely suppressed smile as the warm flame dances across her face and amber eyes.
data.story: 刚拧开家门，屋里没开大灯，只有门后一点跳动的暖黄烛光。穿着柔软藕粉毛衣的夏目端着插了根小蜡烛的草莓蛋糕站在玄关，耳根通红却依然绷着声音——「快点许愿吹灭，奶油都要化了……生日快乐。」
